subject: Follow-up: Pricing & model-mix — token volumes and next steps
message_1_subject: Follow-up: Pricing & model-mix — token volumes and next steps
message_1_body:
Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great to learn more about Acme's roadmap for in-product AI. Quick recap + ask so we can size pricing more accurately: 

Recap from our call:
- Primary use: in-app assistant for customer support (chat) + post-chat embedding-based search + periodic rerank for top-N recommendations.
- Target go-live: Q3 2027 pilot, expand in Q4.
- Current user surface: ~1.2M monthly active users; expected pilot footprint ~50k MAUs.

To get you an apples-to-apples cost estimate we need token volumes and a rough budget range. Can you confirm the following (ballpark is fine):
1) Expected monthly LLM activity during pilot (messages per day or tokens/day) for each model type:
   - Chat (assistant responses, average tokens per response)
   - Embeddings (documents/month and embed calls per user)
   - Rerank (queries/month and average candidate set size)
2) Any hard budget constraints for the pilot (target $/1M tokens or target monthly spend)?
3) Model quality targets (are you OK with quantized/open models, or do you require higher-accuracy variants)?

Attached is the Redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx that shows our baseline unit economics and example line items. For context, our typical starting guidance for pilots (subject to model mix):
- Chat (general purpose chat-capable model): $8–$25 per 1M tokens depending on model family and quantization options
- Embeddings: $3–$10 per 1M tokens (smaller models cheaper)
- Rerank/light inference: $5–$18 per 1M tokens

If you can share rough token estimates, I’ll run a model-mix cost projection and propose 2 budget scenarios (conservative vs. aggressive). Also looping Rishi for a quick unit-econ view.

Next steps: if easier, we can do a 20-min follow-up tomorrow to walk the pricing sheet together.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

message_2_subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing & model-mix — token volumes and next steps
message_2_body:
Thanks Marissa — helpful recap.

Answers (ballpark for pilot footprint):
- Chat: ~60k messages/day, average 120 tokens generated per response (we expect heavier context on certain flows so please assume peak of 200 tokens).
- Embeddings: ~150k embed calls/month (we index ~1.5M doc snippets but initial pilot only uses ~150k).
- Rerank: ~40k queries/month with average candidate set 10.

Budget: pilot target is to stay under $12k / month if possible. If needed we can stretch to $18k for higher accuracy models but would prefer <$12k.

Quality: prefer higher-accuracy chat model for assistant; embeddings can use smaller models if we see acceptable MRR. Rerank should be mid-tier.

Happy to do a quick call tomorrow 10–10:30am PT to review your projection.

—Alex
Head of Product, Acme Corporation
alex.johnson@acme.com
message_3_subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing & model-mix — token volumes and next steps
message_3_body:
Looping in a quick unit-econ sketch based on Alex's numbers (pilot):

Assumptions (pilot):
- Chat: 60k messages/day * 120 avg tokens = 7.2M tokens/day => ~216M tokens/month (30d).
- Embeddings: 150k calls/month * 1 embed = 150k tokens-equivalent (we price embeddings per 1M tokens but they typically cost less).
- Rerank: 40k queries/month * 10 candidates * 20 tokens per candidate ~ 8M tokens/month.

Total tokens (approx): ~232M tokens/month dominated by chat.

Suggested model mix and target $/1M tokens to meet Alex's pilot budget ($12k/month):
- Chat (high-quality): model: redwood-chat-v1 (quantized option available) — target price: $12 per 1M tokens
- Embeddings: embed-small-v1 — target price: $4 per 1M tokens
- Rerank: rerank-light-v1 — target price: $6 per 1M tokens

Cost projection (monthly):
- Chat: 216M tokens -> 216 * $12 / 1M = $2,592 (Note: calculation should be 216 * $12 = $2,592, but tokens are in millions: 216M -> 216 * $12 = $2,592)
- Embeddings: 0.15M tokens -> 0.15 * $4 = $0.60 -> essentially negligible at pilot scale
- Rerank: 8M tokens -> 8 * $6 = $48

Total estimated spend (raw model costs): ~$2,640 / month.

Notes:
- The above numbers assume Redwood's per-token unit pricing only. Add-ons that impact cost: streaming overhead, extra context fetching, and rate-limited concurrency may change effective cost 10–30%.
- If you need to use a higher-accuracy (bigger) chat model, per-1M price could go to $20–25 which would push pilot past $12k if token volume stays as-is.

Recommendation: given Alex's pilot budget, chat token volumes and target $12k/month, there's significant headroom — either the token estimates are conservative or the expected context length will be higher in practice. Next steps: Marissa — can we confirm whether the 60k messages/day is messages initiated by users or total conversation turns? That changes tokens by ~2x. Also would like any target SLA/latency needs that would force a higher-cost hosting option.

-Rishi
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
message_4_subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing & model-mix — token volumes and next steps
message_4_body:
Thanks Alex — super helpful.

Couple quick clarifications so we can finalize the projection: 
- Alex: when you say 60k messages/day, is that user-initiated messages or total assistant responses? If user-initiated, current calc assumes one assistant response per message (120 tokens). If you typically have 2\u20133 turns per conversation that changes the math.
- Priya: any latency/SLA requirements? If you need <200ms p99 we may recommend Dedicated capacity which has a slightly different pricing structure (we can show a committed rate).

I'll schedule the 20-min call for tomorrow 10:00am PT and bring the pricing sheet + a model-mix projection (conservative vs. aggressive) and the attachment with a sample mutual action plan (MA_plan.pdf). If you want an NDA signed before we share any internal perf benchmarks, say the word.

Marissa
